letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Junior Software Engineer role with Example Hiring Team. My background combines Node.js API work, automated testing, React development, and a practical focus on accessible user workflows. The position is a strong match for the areas I have developed through my internship and independent project work.

During my Software Engineering Internship at Example Studio, I built appointment-conflict validation in a Node.js API and added regression tests covering overlapping bookings. I also replaced an inaccessible date picker with a keyboard-operated booking flow after testing it with the product team. This experience taught me to connect backend reliability with the usability of the interface people depend on.

In my Booking Lab project, I built an appointment scheduler using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with persistent storage and automated tests for booking conflicts. I documented the tradeoff between database constraints and application validation and provided a reproducible local demo. That work strengthened my ability to explain technical choices clearly while keeping implementation and verification closely connected.

I would bring hands-on experience relevant to your Node.js API testing requirement, alongside React skills and direct accessibility work. I want to be transparent that my supplied record does not yet document Kubernetes operations experience. I would welcome the opportunity to build that capability while contributing in the areas where I already have a solid foundation.

I would value the opportunity to discuss how my experience building tested scheduling workflows and accessible interfaces could support your team as a junior engineer. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Zoë Șerban
